label: Sense bridge MUTABLE_2 to MUTABLE_1: what another can change is in potency in itself
paraphrase: OPEN sense bridge MUTABLE_2 to MUTABLE_1 (attribution deferred): whatever some other being has power to change is in potency in itself in some respect. Q.9 a.2 keeps the two channels apart; a dependent being with no potency in itself (an emanated pure intelligence) would deny this bridge.
